blush-canvas.$description: Blush Canvas — Primary page background, section backgrounds, hero canvas — the warm paper tone that carries every screen

ink-navy.$description: Ink Navy — Primary text, headings, nav links, body copy, input borders — the only dark anchor in the system

coral-vermillion.$description: Coral Vermillion — Outlined link/action borders, active nav underline, button borders — the single warm accent that gives interactive elements their warmth

dusty-peach.$description: Dusty Peach — Secondary surface tint, card accents, illustration fills — the softer sibling of the canvas

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Botanical illustration dark foliage — the deepest green in the artwork palette

olive-grove.$description: Olive Grove — Botanical illustration mid-tone leaves and stems

mustard-bloom.$description: Mustard Bloom — Botanical illustration flower accents — warm yellow punctuation in the foliage

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Botanical illustration bright flower highlights — the vividest warm note in the artwork

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Botanical illustration soft greenery, dot patterns — the coolest note in the foliage

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Botanical illustration line work, fine stroke details

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

canela-web.$description: Display and headings — ultra-light 100 weight at 120px for the couple's names creates a high-contrast, fashion-editorial feeling. The 0.85 line-height at display size lets descenders and ascenders nearly touch. Mid-weights at 28-48px for section headings, all in serif italics where the brand allows.

calibre.$description: Body, UI, labels, and secondary headings. The 0.2em letter-spacing transforms body text into small-caps labels and tracked section markers ("OUR STORY", "OCTOBER 18TH 2019"). Weight 300 for body paragraphs, 500 for emphasis. This font carries all functional text while Canela handles the poetry.
